instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt cap is reached, and
reaching the cap is charged the full cap. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

 "content": "def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # The horizontal line of 1s and colored markers is the baseline.
    base = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if any(v != 0 for v in row)), None)
    if base is None:
        return out
    row = grid[base]
    for c, marker in enumerate(row):
        if marker in (0, 1):
            continue
        left = 0
        j = c - 1
        while j >= 0 and row[j] == 1:
            left += 1
            j -= 1
        right = 0
        j = c + 1
        while j < len(row) and row[j] == 1:
            right += 1
            j += 1
        height = max(left, right)
        marker_row = base - height - 1
        if marker_row >= 0:
            out[marker_row][c] = marker
            for r in range(marker_row + 1, base):
                out[r][c] = 1
    return out
